## The problem

Restore a classroom computer to a verified working state without exposing device or user information.

## Evidence and verification

Record the symptom, safe inspection, hypothesis, approved change, and repeatable test. Remove serial numbers, account names, network details, and private labels from images.

## Reflection

Explain which test separated the successful repair from a coincidental improvement.
